# FFmpeg 7.1.3's avutil, swresample, swscale, avcodec and avformat as static libraries,
# for faf-re's configuration (see README.md), built with clang-cl for x64 or x86.
#
# The sources and flags come from faf/<arch>/sources.cmake and the configuration
# headers from faf/<arch>/, both generated by faf/generate.sh from FFmpeg's configure
# and Makefiles. Nothing here changes FFmpeg's sources.
#
# Use from a parent project:
#   add_subdirectory(<this repository>/faf ffmpeg)
#   target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE FFmpeg::FFmpeg)
#
# Targets: ffmpeg_avutil, ffmpeg_swresample, ffmpeg_swscale, ffmpeg_avcodec,
# ffmpeg_avformat (STATIC; output names avutil.lib etc.) and FFmpeg::FFmpeg (INTERFACE:
# the public include directories and all five libraries with their system libraries).
#
# The C runtime follows CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY: the parent project's, or static (/MT)
# when this folder is built on its own.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(ffmpeg_faf VERSION 7.1.3 LANGUAGES C)

if(NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang" OR NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "FFmpeg (faf/): the configuration in faf/<arch>/ was generated for clang-cl; "
                      "configure with clang-cl as the C compiler.")
endif()

get_filename_component(FFMPEG_FAF_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  set(FFMPEG_FAF_ARCH x64)
else()
  set(FFMPEG_FAF_ARCH x86)
endif()
set(FFMPEG_FAF_CONFIG_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${FFMPEG_FAF_ARCH}")
include("${FFMPEG_FAF_CONFIG_DIR}/sources.cmake")

# Under a parent project the libraries use the parent's runtime, whatever it is.
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL AND NOT DEFINED CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY)
  set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()

# FFmpeg's own optimisation and flags in every configuration (FFMPEG_FAF_COMPILE_OPTIONS
# carries configure's -O2): FFmpeg relies on dead-code elimination for disabled
# components and does not link unoptimised. No NDEBUG either, as in FFmpeg's build.
foreach(_config DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_${_config} "")
endforeach()

# The public header FFmpeg's build generates (libavutil/avconfig.h), on its own so that
# users of FFmpeg::FFmpeg do not see config.h.
configure_file("${FFMPEG_FAF_CONFIG_DIR}/libavutil/avconfig.h"
               "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/libavutil/avconfig.h" COPYONLY)

# Dependencies between the libraries (configure's <lib>_deps).
set(_ffmpeg_deps_avutil "")
set(_ffmpeg_deps_swresample avutil)
set(_ffmpeg_deps_swscale avutil)
set(_ffmpeg_deps_avcodec avutil)
set(_ffmpeg_deps_avformat avcodec avutil)

set(FFMPEG_FAF_LIBRARIES "")
foreach(_lib avutil swresample swscale avcodec avformat)
  string(TOUPPER "${_lib}" _LIB)
  set(_sources "${FFMPEG_FAF_${_LIB}_SOURCES}")
  list(TRANSFORM _sources PREPEND "${FFMPEG_FAF_SOURCE_DIR}/")
  add_library(ffmpeg_${_lib} STATIC ${_sources})
  set_target_properties(ffmpeg_${_lib} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME ${_lib} FOLDER "dependencies/ffmpeg")
  # FFmpeg's compile command: -I. -I$(SRC_PATH) $(CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS), plus what
  # ffbuild/library.mak adds for library objects.
  target_include_directories(ffmpeg_${_lib} PRIVATE
    "${FFMPEG_FAF_CONFIG_DIR}" "${FFMPEG_FAF_SOURCE_DIR}" ${FFMPEG_FAF_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
  target_compile_definitions(ffmpeg_${_lib} PRIVATE
    ${FFMPEG_FAF_DEFINITIONS} HAVE_AV_CONFIG_H BUILDING_${_lib})
  target_compile_options(ffmpeg_${_lib} PRIVATE ${FFMPEG_FAF_COMPILE_OPTIONS})
  target_include_directories(ffmpeg_${_lib} INTERFACE
    "${FFMPEG_FAF_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
  foreach(_dep IN LISTS _ffmpeg_deps_${_lib})
    target_link_libraries(ffmpeg_${_lib} PUBLIC ffmpeg_${_dep})
  endforeach()
  target_link_libraries(ffmpeg_${_lib} PUBLIC ${FFMPEG_FAF_${_LIB}_SYSTEM_LIBS})
  list(APPEND FFMPEG_FAF_LIBRARIES ffmpeg_${_lib})
endforeach()

add_library(ffmpeg_faf INTERFACE)
add_library(FFmpeg::FFmpeg ALIAS ffmpeg_faf)
target_link_libraries(ffmpeg_faf INTERFACE
  ffmpeg_avformat ffmpeg_avcodec ffmpeg_swscale ffmpeg_swresample ffmpeg_avutil)

# For a parent project that wants to add options to every FFmpeg library.
if(NOT PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
  set(FFMPEG_FAF_LIBRARIES "${FFMPEG_FAF_LIBRARIES}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endif()
